description: This file defines the QhullQh class, a C++ wrapper for the qhT data structure used in the Qhull computational geometry library. It includes class members, methods for messaging, configuration, and error handling, as well as macros for error handling with setjmp/longjmp.

classes.name: orgQhull::QhullQh
classes.description: A C++ class representing Qhull's global data structure, qhT, with methods for configuration, messaging, and error handling.

methods.name: factorEpsilon
methods.description: Returns the current factor epsilon used for geometric calculations.

methods.name: setFactorEpsilon
methods.description: Sets the factor epsilon for geometric calculations.

methods.name: appendQhullMessage
methods.description: Appends a message to the internal message buffer.

methods.name: qhullMessage
methods.description: Returns the current message buffer as a string.

methods.name: hasOutputStream
methods.description: Checks if output stream is enabled.

methods.name: hasQhullMessage
methods.description: Checks if there is a message stored.

methods.name: maybeThrowQhullMessage
methods.description: Throws an exception if a message indicates an error.

methods.name: angleEpsilon
methods.description: Returns the epsilon value for hyperplane angle comparisons.

methods.name: checkAndFreeQhullMemory
methods.description: Checks and frees Qhull memory resources.

methods.name: distanceEpsilon
methods.description: Returns the epsilon value for distance comparisons.
